title: Capability index stays inside its budget without dropping tokens tests pin when modules are added
body:
Why: lane refactor-context (#823) added eight src modules; the 9500-char capability index truncated the src/state/sandbox-placeholders.ts header and dropped `.mcp.json`, turning test capability-index red. Every new module can push another line under the cut.
Outcome: the index budget cuts lines by a deterministic rule a test pins (e.g. header summary capped per line, total budget checked with headroom), and no asserted token can fall out because another module was added.
Proof: a test adds N synthetic modules and asserts every pinned token survives.
